standard_tasks: Confirm travel dates, passport/visa requirements, and destination entry advisories.
Book round-trip transportation (flights, train passes, or rental vehicle).
Reserve centrally located accommodations matching budget tier (hotel, boutique inn, or apartment).
Acquire local transit passes, mobile eSIM/data connectivity, and currency exchange.
Day 1: Arrival, check-in, neighborhood orientation walk, and signature local dinner.
Day 2: Morning cultural heritage landmarks, afternoon museum/art exploration, and evening culinary food tour.
Day 3: Scenic outdoor/nature excursion, souvenir shopping in historic artisan markets, and farewell dinner.
Curate packing checklist tailored to regional weather forecast.
Identify backup indoor activities in case of inclement weather.
Arrange airport/station return transfers and prepare checkout checklist.

typical_risks.risk: Inclement weather disrupting outdoor walking tours
typical_risks.mitigation: Schedule flexible museum/indoor passes with open-date vouchers.
Reserve skip-the-line timed entry tickets at least 2 weeks in advance.
Pre-download offline transit maps and regional metro navigation apps.

name: SaaS Product MVP & Software Launch Blueprint

standard_tasks: Define product requirements document (PRD) and core user journey wireframes.
Setup repository, CI/CD pipeline, database schemas, and authentication scaffolding.
Implement the primary core feature workflow with minimal viable UX.
Integrate payment gateway (Stripe) and subscription webhook handlers.
Implement telemetry logging, error boundary monitoring, and input validation guardrails.
Execute automated end-to-end user journey tests and load stress tests.
Deploy production build to managed cloud hosting with SSL and custom domain.
Write technical user documentation, FAQ, and onboarding walkthrough.
Onboard first cohort of beta testers, gather feedback metrics, and triage critical bugs.

typical_risks.mitigation: Enforce strict feature freeze; push non-core items to v1.1 backlog.
Implement client-side caching (Redis) and exponential backoff retries.

standard_tasks: Draft event agenda, judging rubric, and participant eligibility rules.
Secure venue / streaming infrastructure and audio-visual tech support.
Outreach to sponsors for prize pool, API credits, and judge recruitment.
Launch registration portal and promotional social campaign.
Procure catering, participant swag, badges, and high-speed Wi-Fi provisioning.
Host pre-event info session and publish mentor office-hours schedule.
Conduct opening keynote, team formation, and live challenge kickoff.
Facilitate mentor check-in rounds and project submission deadline.
Run demo pitch evaluations, announce winners, and distribute digital certificates.

typical_risks.risk: Network connectivity failure during live demos
typical_risks.mitigation: Provision dedicated redundant 5G cellular hotspot backup.
Over-admit by 20% and run a guided team formation mixer at kickoff.
